in-scope.item: Inheritance model: Global Defaults → Company Defaults → Form Overrides → Component Overrides (four tiers)
Company Settings: Form Branding Defaults page (Dashboard → Company container → Company Settings)
Page contains: Global Properties controls + Toolbox components as visual guide (live preview)
Company-level defaults persistence in DB with versioning + audit trail
Builder UX: inherited vs overridden; "Save to Company Defaults" button on Global Properties Panel
Audit trail viewable in Company Settings → Form Branding Defaults
Shared resolver applies defaults; Preview + renderer use same resolution rules
Form Builder Init API: POST /api/form-builder/init with companyId, eventId; single payload (defaults + component catalog + DefinitionJSON skeleton)
Form context: CompanyID + EventID (Event.CountryID) define criteria; API returns components (Global ∪ Country ∪ Company)
Frontend manages changes; writes complete DefinitionJSON back on save
Component catalog (database-driven): components scoped Global, Country, or Company
